caption: P3 receives m2 before m1. The causal test fails because P1's component is still 0, so m2 waits in the buffer until m1 arrives.

spec.aria: Sequence diagram: P1 sends m1 with vector (1,0,0) to P2 and P3; P2 sends m2 with vector (1,1,0) to P3; the delayed copy of m1 reaches P3 after m2, so P3 buffers m2.
